item.title: OCM @ Sovereign Cloud Days 2026: Sovereign Cloud and Air-Gapped Delivery
item.description:
Sovereign Cloud Days 2026 in Saarbrücken

From October 22 to 25, 2026, the Sovereign Cloud Days brought decision-makers, operators, and the open source community together in Saarbrücken under one motto: Digital Sovereignty. Open. Practical. Now. The weekend belonged to the community-organized OpenInfra & Cloud Native Track on the campus of htw saar, run in cooperation with the OpenInfra Foundation and the CNCF. No vendor pitches, just real experiences from production operations.

item.title: We did a Hackathon!
item.description:
Hackathon @ SAP Innovation Center Potsdam

From 21.07.2026 to 24.07.2026 we attended an SAP Hackathon @ SAP Innovation Center in Potsdam. This is one of, if not the best, locations that SAP has around the globe. SAP was so nice to provide us with food, drinks and a lovely set of people to work together with on interesting projects in the IPCEI-CIS initiative.
